selection_rule: Declared before any run: per listed stratum, the first 3 valid_feasible benchmark samples in declared seed order (feasibility classes only, never kinematic outcomes): 8 ID strata (24 episodes) and A_OOD (3: pose/size OOD, where Native-specific reach, tracking and grasp effects concentrate). A stratum with fewer than 3 valid_feasible samples runs what it has and records the shortfall; every unselected sample keeps its reason.

success_definition.source: configs/wp12/workcell_live_v1.json task_success_requires (Phase 2b, amended 2026-10-31 to the stricter WP-11 grasp warning gates)
task_success_requires: goal evaluator verdict PASS (goal_eval_v2a on the live recorded oracle history)
the scripted plan reached DONE within the episode (task_end_reason CONTROLLER_DONE)
finite recorded material state and no solver error
no GRASP_FAILURE in the task phase (slip > 0.002 m or rotation > pi/60 rad: grasp_monitor warning gates)
no IK_FAILURE in the task phase (any IK status other than ok, or any workspace-clamped command)
success_definition.classifier: scripts/run_wp12_workcell_live_analysis.py (GL.classify_live with GRASP_GATES and the IK / clamp counts) on the attempt directory
success_definition.mapping: classify_live TASK_SUCCESS -> task_success; GRASP_FAILURE -> execution_failure grasp; IK_FAILURE (IK not ok, workspace clamp, or a Native plan-preflight IK refusal) and a SCENE_INFEASIBLE refusal -> execution_failure other (reason kept); CUTTING_FAILURE 'solver state invalid' -> solver_invalid, 'plan did not finish' -> plan_not_finished, 'integrity' -> integrity, 'outcome' -> outcome; a LAUNCHED attempt without an episode result (classify_live NOT_RUN) -> execution_failure crash; only a selected sample never launched is not_run (it stays in the feasible denominator)
success_definition.status: DECLARED. run_wp12_phase5.native_execution is PROVISIONAL and less strict (no grasp gates, no IK/clamp counts, preflight refusal -> not_run): it must be replaced by this definition, CPU-tested against the Phase 2b records (workcell_live_001-007 classes reproduced), before the first Native benchmark episode; until then no Native benchmark episode runs.
success_definition.home_outcome: reported separately (HOME reset and physical return), never part of task success

scope: Live Native Isaac Sim 6.2 episodes (runtime_source live_isaac_sim) of the declared stratified sub-sample (27 of 170 benchmark samples). Denominators: the selected valid_feasible samples of each stratum (not the whole stratum). Kinematic classes are KINEMATIC ideal-tracking results of the same sample ids (artifacts/wp12/phase5_001/kinematic_benchmark), not live.
